name: PDF Agile
summary: Desktop PDF editor for editing text and images, converting PDFs to Word, merging pages, signing, annotating, OCR and compression, sold as one-time-payment plans instead of a subscription.
best_for: individuals, students and teachers who edit, convert and sign PDFs regularly and prefer paying once over a monthly subscription
skip_if: you will use it for work and do not want to ask for written permission for commercial use, or you need clear terms on what a time-limited plan keeps after it ends
honest_knock: The Semi-Annual and Annual plans are one-time payments tied to an upgrade period, and the pricing page does not say whether the paid features keep working once that period ends. The licence covers personal, non-commercial use only; commercial use needs separate written permission from the company. The refund policy excludes change of mind and purchases more than 30 days old.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Semi-Annual · one-time payment with 6 months of upgrades and priority support
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on pdfagile.com/pricing; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) PDF Agile sells three paid plans and calls each of them a one-time payment rather than a subscription. Semi-Annual is $39 (shown as $6.5 a month) with 6 months of upgrades and priority support; Annual is $59 (shown as $4.9 a month) with 1 year of upgrades and priority support; Lifetime is $119, marked as a 60%-off limited-time offer against $295, with free lifetime upgrades. All three list the same features: editing text and images in PDFs, PDF-to-Word conversion, merging and reordering pages, signing and protecting, annotating, batch conversion, OCR and compression. The free version limits conversion to 2 pages and 5 tasks. The page does not say whether the paid features keep working after the upgrade period of the Semi-Annual and Annual plans ends, and gives no end date for the Lifetime offer.
